onboarding.step2Title: Pin the pages you use often

onboarding.step3Title: Jump to any tab with a few keystrokes
onboarding.step3Body: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K to focus search, type a title, URL, or pinyin initials, then ↑↓ to pick and Enter to switch.
onboarding.feature1: Context menus: right-click a page / link / tab bar to hibernate, pin, or search by domain
onboarding.feature2: Address bar command: type t plus keywords to jump to tabs and pinned items
onboarding.feature3: Undo history: every close can be undone, so mis-closes are safe
onboarding.feature4: Toolbar badge: live duplicate count / total tabs

about.title: About Tabs
about.entryHint: Open a standalone page listing every capability and shortcut
about.tagline: A local-first tab workbench — no account, no cloud
about.domTabs1Body: The groups you see in the panel are the browser's own tab groups: collapsing, renaming and recoloring all land in the browser, so both sides always agree.
about.domTabs2Body: Tabs from the same domain gather into one group; optionally mirror that grouping into native browser groups (off by default).
about.domTabs3Body: Duplicate counts, mute / playing, split view and hibernation are marked at the end of each row — no need to open anything.
about.domFixed1Body: Where long-term assets live: create, rename, reorder, open all at once, export to browser bookmarks.
about.domFixed2Body: Pin your go-to pages to the top for one-tap access; middle-click closes the page without removing the tile.
about.domFixed3Body: Items stay in their folder after the tab closes and rebind when reopened — saved links are never lost.
about.domFixed4Body: Import browser bookmark folders as Fixed space folders in bulk — no manual migration.
about.domSearch1Body: Titles, URLs and pinyin initials all match together (typing zhw finds 知乎网).
about.domSearch2Body: ↑↓ to roam, Enter to activate, Esc to clear; matched fragments are highlighted.
about.domSearch3Body: Turn it on to search tabs in every window and jump straight to the hit (current window only by default).
about.domSearch4Body: ⌘P / Ctrl+P searches commands and tabs in one place, and runs actions like hibernate all or save a snapshot.
about.domDrag1Body: Tabs, always-on tiles, group headers and folder items all support drag reordering, consistently.
about.domDrag2Body: Drop into Fixed space or a folder to file it; duplicate URLs are deduped instead of stored twice.
about.domDrag3Body: Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space again to drop — organize without a mouse.
about.domDup1Body: Keeps the active / pinned / earliest tab per URL; pinned tabs and Fixed space items are exempt, and the cleanup is undoable.
about.domDup2Body: Opening a URL that is already open merges into the existing tab (can be turned off; notice optional).
about.domDup3Body: An n× marker on the row, plus a "Clean up duplicates" entry in the footer showing how many are pending.
about.domUndo1Body: Every close made through Tabs goes on the stack (depth configurable) — one click to take it back.
about.domUndo2Body: Restore any batch at any time; automatic actions are labeled with their source instead of happening anonymously.
about.domUndo3Body: Even tabs closed by the browser itself can be recovered; failed restores stay in history for a retry.
about.domSnapshot1Body: Named save of the current window, archive (save and close), save Fixed space, or paste OneTab text.
about.domSnapshot2Body: On by default with a rolling window of recent saves — crashes and force-quits are covered too.
about.domSnapshot3Body: Only missing tabs are created, with pinned, muted and group state restored — nothing is opened twice.
about.domSnapshot4Body: Snapshot, archive and preserved-tab counts aggregated locally; no network or account involved.
about.domDiscard1Body: Single tab, batch-hibernate inactive tabs, or scheduled auto-hibernation — undoable, with a domain whitelist.
about.domDiscard2Body: One click in the footer wakes every hibernated tab, exactly as it was.
about.domDiscard3Body: Optional notification when auto-hibernation runs; undo stays available in the panel either way.
about.domData1Body: Fixed space, settings and every snapshot and archive exported as a single JSON; import is transactional and rolls back on failure.
about.domData2Body: Folders and settings can sync across devices through your own browser account — never through a Tabs server.
about.domData3Body: All persisted data is schema-validated; corrupted entries are isolated rather than silently dropped or spread.
about.domData4Body: Technical logs (no tab titles or URLs) are kept locally and can be exported when something goes wrong.
about.domDev1Body: Matching sites get forced no-store response headers (subresources included) — the equivalent of DevTools' Disable cache.
about.domDev2Body: Domain, domain + path, or full URL prefix — up to 50 entries, one per line.
about.domDev3Body: Matching tabs show a marker in the side panel, so you can see the scope at a glance.
about.domDev4Body: Site access is requested optionally: leave the feature off and installing never asks for access to all sites.
about.domLook1Body: The whole interface is bilingual and follows your browser language.
about.domLook2Body: System / light / dark, plus five color schemes, with a smooth transition when switching.
about.domLook3Body: Compact, cozy or large text — for long lists and low-vision use alike.
about.domLook4Body: No native browser dialogs; settings includes a full shortcut table with a link to the browser's extension shortcuts page.
about.entry1Body: Four contexts — page, link, tab bar and toolbar icon: hibernate, pin, search by domain, add to folder, open panel and settings.
about.entry2Body: Type t, press Tab, then type keywords to jump straight to tabs, pinned items and folders.
about.entry3Body: The badge can show the tab count, duplicate groups or hibernated count — four modes (auto / tabs / duplicates / off).
about.entry4Body: ⌘P (Ctrl+P): search commands and tabs, and run actions directly.
about.entry5Body: Drag go-to pages to the top tiles, or into folders in Fixed space, for one-tap access anytime.
about.globalShortcutsHint: These can be changed on the browser's extension shortcuts page.
about.privacy1Body: Primary storage is browser local storage (chrome.storage.local) — no servers of our own, no account, no cloud.
about.privacy2Body: The extension itself makes no network requests; a build-time privacy regression check enforces this.
about.privacy3Body: Cross-device mirroring goes through your own browser account; Tabs takes no part and sees nothing.
about.privacy4Body: The permission list is frozen in the build config and the privacy docs; any addition must change both first.
about.privacy5Body: Diagnostics log only technical context (time, module, error) — never tab titles or URLs.
about.tech1Body: WXT + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + zustand + zod.
about.tech2Body: Vitest behavior specs, UI render baselines, design-token guards and a privacy regression — 800+ cases.
about.footerNote: No servers of our own, no account, no telemetry, zero outbound requests; your data lives in your browser by default.
about.footerLicense: Open source under the MIT license.
